title: Melting Canine Tower
description: A surreal scene shows a tall pink rectangular tower covered in black and white dog silhouettes, with orange and pink liquid dripping down its sides and pooling on the ground. In the foreground, a red-haired figure in a dark coat stands with arms outstretched toward two glowing orbs containing miniature scenes, while a large anthropomorphic moon with a human face, red lips, and orange tears dominates the pink sky.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic scene with a tall pink rectangular tower covered in repeating black and white dog silhouettes melting with thick orange and pink liquid dripping down. A large anthropomorphic moon with a human female face, blue eyes, red lips and orange tears floating in a pink sky. In the foreground a red-haired person in a dark hooded coat stands with back to viewer, arms outstretched holding two glowing circular orbs showing miniature scenes inside. Purple flowers on the ground, dripping liquid effects, dreamlike atmosphere.
